sonnet.problem: This choice card asks about verse 28 (Bethany beyond the Jordan) before any story card has told that verse. Story card 16 tells it afterward. So the card jumps ahead, and the baker has nothing to reason from. The baker can only guess. The question also says the visitors 'came from Jerusalem', but verse 19 says only that the Jews of Jerusalem sent them.
sonnet.rule: Cards follow the passage in order. A choice card can look back at a verse an earlier card in the same stop told, but never jumps ahead.
